_about: Target-measurement calibration for the live viewer (processing.targets). Edit and restart the viewer server. Values marked calibrated=false are assumptions, and the UI labels results from them as uncalibrated.

range.basis: Three-point corner-reflector fit 2026-10-07 at the stock 204.3 MHz sweep: distance = 0.75 m x bin + 0.14 m (+/-10%). Scaled by 204.3/240.3 for the installed 240 MHz sweep (stretch x1.18 measured). Re-measure at 240 MHz.

angle.basis: Assumed half-wavelength receiver spacing; boresight offset and sign not yet measured (RX2-RX1 phase was -5 to +9 deg for a reflector straight ahead on 2026-10-07).

velocity.basis: Positive Doppler bin reported as positive velocity; which direction that is has not been checked.

detection._cells: [range bins, Doppler bins]. Threshold is over the cell-averaging CFAR noise estimate. min_doppler_bin applies only when static removal is on.
